I am 50 and I have farmed this 10.9 mu for 30 years. I never went to school but I know my land. I do wheat in winter and maize in summer, same as everyone in my village.

For wheat, I sow in October after the corn comes off. I buy improved seeds from the dealer, about 15 jin per mu. Before sowing I spread 10 bags of compound fertilizer, 50kg each bag. That is almost one bag per mu. In March when the wheat turns green I spread 4 bags of urea, 40kg each. At jointing time in April I spread another 4 bags of urea. I do not want my wheat to starve. A bad harvest is a disaster. I irrigate three times from my well: once in winter if there is no snow, once at jointing, and once when the grain is filling. I spray herbicide once after the wheat comes up, insecticide once when I see bugs, and fungicide once because my neighbors do it too. I rotary till the land after maize harvest. Last year I got 1000 jin per mu. I expect the same this year.

For maize, after wheat harvest in early June I sow right away. I use hybrid seeds, about 3 jin per mu, new seeds every year. I put 8 bags of compound fertilizer in the furrow at sowing. When the corn is knee high I side-dress 3 bags of urea. At tasseling I put another 3 bags of urea. I irrigate twice: once when it tassels, once when the grain fills. I spray herbicide once after sowing, and insecticide once for the corn borer. I use the no-till seeder because there is no time between wheat harvest and maize sowing. Last year I got about 1100 jin per mu. My sons work in the city so I hire two people for two days at maize harvest. I spend a lot on fertilizer but I would rather waste some money than lose the crop. I do what my neighbors do.
